notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Source: 2025 annual report on Form 20-F (accession 0001140361-26-017486, filed April 28, 2026), read on EDGAR; financial statements are in thousands of Mexican pesos (IFRS), recorded here in billions of MXN with no FX conversion. The new-year ifrs-full facts are not yet in SEC companyfacts, so no xbrl objects are given. OWNERSHIP (as of March 31, 2026, percentages of the 60,195 million B Shares outstanding, per footnote 1; the 20-F does not say whether treasury shares are excluded): the 20-F lists three holders above 5%, all linked to the Slim Family: the Family Trust 29.5%, Control Empresarial de Capitales 18.1%, and Carlos Slim Helú 8.6% (5,200 million shares, unchanged; the percentages rose because the share count fell with buybacks). They are recorded as three non-overlapping figures: Carlos Slim's own 8.6% as the leader, the Family Trust as the family figure, and Control Empresarial de Capitales as a holder. The 20-F's 22.9% for direct holdings of all Slim Family members is NOT recorded because it includes Carlos Slim's 8.6% (overlap); it says no family member other than Carlos Slim Helú individually directly owns more than 5.0%. No all-inclusive family total is stated, and the figures were not summed. pctVoting is null because there is a single series with one vote per share. Relation 'founder' follows data.js; the 20-F does not use the word. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow line 'Dividends paid' (Ps.33,159,586 thousand) does not separate dividends to non-controlling interests; the statement of changes in equity shows 2025 dividends declared of Ps.31,388,472 thousand to owners of the parent and Ps.2,196,223 thousand to non-controlling interests, and the MD&A says 'We paid Ps.33.2 billion in dividends in 2025'. No figure for dividends paid to the company's own shareholders alone is stated, so the cash line is used and labelled as total; nothing was subtracted. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line (Ps.11,944,156 thousand); the MD&A says the company spent Ps.11.9 billion repurchasing its own shares in the open market in 2025. STOCK COMP: null; the 20-F discloses no share-based compensation expense or employee share plan. GEOGRAPHY: external revenues (after removing intersegment revenues) by the company's reportable segments; they sum to consolidated total revenues. 'Uruguay, Paraguay and Chile' includes Claro Chile, consolidated after its acquisition (note 12 a).
